summary.text: Noah Smith is the Republican candidate for Tennessee House of Representatives District 36 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he is the only candidate listed; a commercial airline pilot and Campbell County native, he has also served on the Campbell County Board of Education.

paragraphs.text: Noah Smith earned a high school diploma from Campbell County High School and a bachelor's degree from the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, in 2022.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as pilot, and says he was elected to the Campbell County Board of Education on November 6, 2018.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a lifelong Campbell County resident, an Eagle Scout and a commercial airline pilot flying CRJ900 regional jets.
Smith advanced from the Republican primary on August 6, 2026.
His survey listed term limits, supporting local education and the local economy, and infrastructure as key messages, including better roads, bridges, water and high-speed internet.
